activity.overview: Measure with cubes, compare lengths and put things in order.

problems.prompt: A ribbon is 7 cubes long. A string is 4 cubes long. Which is longer? How many cubes longer?
The red snake is longer than the blue snake. The blue snake is longer than the green snake. Which snake is the longest? Which is the shortest?
Put these in order from shortest to longest: a bus, a pencil, a door.
Pick something on your desk. Measure it with cubes. Draw it and write how many cubes long it is.
Lee measured a book and got 9 cubes. Ava measured the same book and got 7 cubes, but she left gaps between her cubes. Whose number is right? Tell why.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Measure and Compare

criteria.title: I measured with no gaps or overlaps
